subjective.historyOfPresentIllness: Fictional 27-year-old presents after twisting their right ankle while playing recreational basketball approximately 2 hours prior. Reports immediate swelling and difficulty bearing weight. Denies numbness or tingling. No prior ankle injuries on this side.

reviewOfSystems.finding: Denies numbness or tingling in the foot.

examFindings.finding: Moderate swelling and ecchymosis over the right lateral malleolus, tender to palpation. No obvious deformity.
Negative Ottawa ankle rules; able to bear weight for four steps with discomfort.

assessment.description: Right lateral ankle sprain, grade II

codedConcept.display: Sprain of unspecified ligament of right ankle, initial encounter

plan.detail: Right ankle X-ray series to rule out fracture, given borderline Ottawa criteria.
Ibuprofen 400mg every 6 hours as needed for pain, with food.
Discussed RICE protocol (rest, ice, compression, elevation) and use of an ankle brace.
Follow up with primary care or orthopedics in 1 week if symptoms have not improved.
